paragraphs: In Rosh Hashanah 22a: he was the head of Gader; he detained the witnesses, and Rabban Gamliel removed him from his high position.[^1]

notes.text: The whole Davidson Rosh Hashanah 22a paragraph names Shezaphar, head of Gader, as detaining the witnesses; Rabban Gamliel sends and they remove him from his position. This supports Hyman’s causal account and local full title without importing the alternative attribution or additional narrative.
